1.explanation:
• lib/util/LabelUtil.js – the function isLabelExternal drives whether an element gets an external label. It currently omits the BPMN message element (bpmn:Message), so message shapes never receive a label. Adding a clause for 'bpmn:Message' here is required.

• lib/import/BpmnImporter.js – after shapes (including message elements) are created, the importer only calls addLabel when isLabelExternal returns true. Because LabelUtil doesn’t include message elements, the importer never attaches the name label. Fixing LabelUtil here will allow the importer to create message element labels.

• lib/draw/BpmnRenderer.js – the renderer is responsible for drawing both the envelope shape and any attached external label. Once the importer has created a label shape, BpmnRenderer.drawShape/drawConnection must render that label in the correct position. Verifying (and if necessary adjusting) the label‐rendering logic in BpmnRenderer ensures the new message element names actually show up on the canvas.
1.bug_scenario: In the supplied BPMN collaboration diagram we see message‐element shapes (small envelope icons) placed along message flows, but their text labels (the message names) are not being rendered. In the screenshot above the red box highlights a message icon with no accompanying label – e.g. the “Отправка” or “Запрос корректировки” names for those message elements never appear.
